modules.name: inventory
modules.description: The player's inventory: currencies, stackable items and unique instances, with exchange by server rules and client-side spending of consumable items.

methods.name: balance
methods.description: Total amount of a currency in the cached state.

currencyId.description: Catalog item id of the currency, e.g. `coins`.

returns.description: Amount as a non-negative integer, or `undefined` when the currency is not in the cached state.

errors.hint: The module is stopped or the player changed.

methods.name: consume
methods.description: Spends `qty` of an item the catalog marks as consumable by the client (hint, extra life, booster). It only decreases the amount; the client never adds items.

itemId.description: Catalog item id, e.g. `hint`.

qty.description: Amount to spend, integer from 1 to 10000.

options.description: `idempotencyKey` is a UUID v4/v7; `reason` is an optional label.

reason.description: Label stored with the operation and sent in `inventory.consumed`: 1-64 characters from `A-Za-z0-9._:-`, e.g. `level_12`.

idempotencyKey.description: UUID v4/v7 of the logical operation; reuse it to retry after a restart.

returns.description: Changed positions (one line with a negative `delta`) and the confirmed state.

inventoryVersion.description: Inventory version after the operation, non-negative integer.

replayed.description: `true` when the result is a replay of an earlier request with the same idempotency key.

itemId.description: Catalog item id of the changed position.

instanceId.description: Instance id for a unique item; `null` for currencies and stacks.

delta.description: Quantity change: negative is spent, positive is received.

balanceAfter.description: Quantity of the position after the change, non-negative integer.

state.description: Confirmed state after the operation; it also replaces the cached state.

inventoryVersion.description: Version of the whole inventory, non-negative integer; grows with every change.

collection.description: Catalog collection the item belongs to, e.g. `currencies`.

itemId.description: Catalog item id of the currency, lowercase key such as `coins`.

stateVersion.description: Version counter of this position, non-negative integer.

updatedAt.description: Last change time, ISO 8601 UTC string; `null` when not provided.

collection.description: Catalog collection the item belongs to.

itemId.description: Catalog item id, lowercase key such as `hint`.

expiresAt.description: Expiry time, ISO 8601 UTC string; `null` when the stack never expires.

stateVersion.description: Version counter of this position, non-negative integer.

updatedAt.description: Last change time, ISO 8601 UTC string; `null` when not provided.

collection.description: Catalog collection the item belongs to.

itemId.description: Catalog item id, lowercase key such as `sword`.

attrs.description: Instance attributes: flat map of string, number or boolean values.

expiresAt.description: Expiry time, ISO 8601 UTC string; `null` when the instance never expires.

stateVersion.description: Version counter of this position, non-negative integer.

updatedAt.description: Last change time, ISO 8601 UTC string; `null` when not provided.
Last change time of the inventory, ISO 8601 UTC string; `null` when never changed.

serverTime.description: Time of the response, ISO 8601 UTC string; expiry checks use it.

errors.hint: Invalid item id, `qty`, `reason` or idempotency key, or the key was used for a different operation.
The item cannot be spent by the client.
The item is not in the catalog.
The player owns less than `qty`.
Too many operations are pending or the service limit is hit.
The module is stopped or the player changed.

methods.name: entities
methods.description: Lists the public catalog (first 100 entries); it has no player quantities.

id.description: Catalog item id, lowercase key such as `hint`.

itemType.description: Item kind as defined in the catalog, e.g. `soft_currency`.

status.description: Catalog status of the item, e.g. `active`.

titleKey.description: Localization key of the title; `null` when not set.

descriptionKey.description: Localization key of the description; `null` when not set.

errors.hint: The module is stopped or the player changed.

methods.example:
const catalog = await sdk.inventory.entities();
const title = catalog.find((e) => e.id === 'hint')?.display.titleKey;

methods.name: expectGrant
methods.description: Labels the next `inventory:items:granted` with `source` (the grant itself comes later: an IAP chest offer, a realtime balance change). The label is used once, or dropped after `ttlMs` (default 60 s) or on the player change.

options.description: `ttlMs`: 1..600000 ms the label waits for a grant.

ttlMs.description: Lifetime of the grant label in milliseconds, 1..600000; default 60000.

errors.hint: Invalid source or ttl.
The module is stopped or the player changed.

events.name: inventory:currency:tap
events.description: The player tapped a currency capsule of the top bar. The host decides what opens (the demo opens the shop on the packs of that currency); the payload carries the currency item id and whether it is a hard currency.

itemId.description: Item id of the tapped currency.

events.name: inventory:items:granted
events.description: A confirmed inventory state has more of some items than the previous one (purchase, offer, daily reward, chest, quest, level win, rewarded ad); the payload lists { id, kind, quantity } of what was received (at most 50 lines, the first read and spends are not grants). The default rule of ui.windows/main shows the UI Kit reward window ui.reward with it.

items.description: Granted lines by item id, sorted, at most 50.

kind.description: Item kind: a currency type, a stackable `item` or a unique `instance`.

quantity.description: How much was received, positive integer (instances are counted).

source.description: Where the grant came from, set by `expectGrant` before the operation, e.g. `chest` (`ui.reward` draws the opened chest only for `chest`); absent when unknown.

events.name: inventory:state:changed
events.description: The cached inventory changed after a read, exchange, consume or server push; the payload lists the ids of the changed items.

changed.description: Sorted item ids whose positions changed, e.g. `["coins","hint"]`.

events.name: inventory:window:close
events.description: Requests the host to close the named window once. The host reports inventory:window:closed with the same view only after unmount, or when presentation was skipped.

view.description: Window to present: one of the `inventory` named windows, e.g. `chests`.

events.name: inventory:window:open
events.description: A named inventory window (main, chests, collection, card, album, shelf, easter, skin) was opened through sdk.ui.open('inventory:<window>'). The host presents the matching UI Kit window.

view.description: Window to present: one of the `inventory` named windows, e.g. `chests`.

id.description: Card, skin or set the window opens for (the `id` open parameter), `null` when none.
